about: Malaysian certification route per role: the closest National Occupational Skills Standard (NOSS / SKPK) by title, looked up by hand. A NOSS leads to a Sijil Kemahiran Malaysia (SKM) at the stated level through JPK-accredited centres or recognition of prior learning (PPT). Listing a NOSS does not mean the certificate is required for the job. 'match' is 'close' when the NOSS title names the same work, 'related' when it covers part of it. Check the current status of a code with JPK before enrolling.
